databaseMigration.reason: Explicit consent events, issue audit, replay observation and revocation linkage require durable append-only persistence; the current electronics conversation schema has no Stage 2 consent lifecycle.

keyLifecycle.active: One ACTIVE key signs and verifies
keyLifecycle.rotation: Prior ACTIVE becomes VERIFY_ONLY until its maximum token TTL elapses
keyLifecycle.rollback: A prior key may become ACTIVE only through a separately approved environment change with an audit event; source and secrets remain unchanged

approvalScope: Exact package digest only; approval authorizes later implementation of durable consent/audit persistence, environment key configuration, 24-category adapter registration and deployment as one separately executed activation, with no Stage 1 membership/ranking/P/Y change.
